language.title: Language
language.body: Orbit speaks in the language you pick here.

today.addPayday: Add a payday to see a daily amount.
today.firstDayWorking: This is your first day. Orbit is still working out your number. Check back in a moment.
today.offlineStale: You're offline. Today's number is from earlier.
today.offlinePurchaseOne: You're offline. This purchase will save when you reconnect.
today.offlinePurchaseMany: You're offline. These purchases will save when you reconnect.
today.queuedOne: 1 purchase is saved on this phone. It sends when you're back online.
today.queuedMany: {count} purchases are saved on this phone. They send when you're back online.
today.poisonOne: 1 saved purchase could not be sent. Add it again if it still matters.
today.poisonMany: {count} saved purchases could not be sent. Add them again if they still matter.
today.staleNumbers: Numbers are from an earlier day. They will refresh overnight.
today.forecastStale: Ahead could not refresh. You are seeing the last one.
today.spendingBelowZero: Spending is below zero. Tomorrow's pace is $0 until payday covers it.
today.breach: {date} drops below the {amount} you want to keep.
today.firstRunCanSpend: This is your first day. Add a purchase and watch the number change.
today.firstRunViewOnly: This is your first day. The number changes when a purchase is added.
today.firstEvening: Add rent whenever you like. Today already works.
today.paydaySheetBody: Payday was due {date}. Enter what arrived.

ahead.title: Ahead
ahead.fallbackSummary: Money in the bank for the next 60 days.
ahead.noEvents: Nothing leaves or arrives in the next 60 days.
ahead.keepBreach: {date} drops below the {amount} you want to keep.
ahead.eventBoth: Payday arrives and bills leave the bank
ahead.narrativeBreach: {event}, and the bank ends the day below the {amount} you want to keep.
ahead.narrativeWarning: {event}, and the bank ends the day close to the {amount} you want to keep.

plan.title: Plan
plan.sweepIncomplete: Some of what was left last payday could not move to your Goals yet.
plan.moveToSpendingHint: Send this money to Spending before you remove the goal.
plan.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? Past paydays stay in the record.
plan.spendingP1: Payday goes to Bills first, then Goals. What is left is Spending.
plan.spendingP2: Orbit splits Spending evenly across the days until the next payday. That share is what you can spend today.
plan.spendingP3: If you spend less, the rest carries to tomorrow. When payday arrives, anything still unspent moves to your Goals.

you.title: You
you.billingBody: Only the owner sees this. Orbit does not charge anything yet.
you.appearanceBody: Light, dark, or the same as this phone.
you.keepAtLeastHint: Orbit will warn you if a coming day falls below this.
you.inviteSubtitle: They join this household with the role you pick.
you.inviteEmailedAndLink: We emailed them. They can also open this once they sign in:
you.inviteLinkOnly: We'll email them when mail is configured. For now, send them this to open after they sign in:
you.inviteFooter: We'll email them when mail is configured.
you.activityEmpty: Nothing yet. Checks show up here after your first purchase or payday.

auth.headline: Know what you can spend today.
auth.subhead: One calm number, paced to your next payday.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in is not configured. Set Resend keys and NEXT_PUBLIC_MAGIC_LINK, or enable local Harbor header auth.
auth.magicLinkError: We could not send that link. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.magicLinkSent: Check your email for a sign-in link. New here? The link opens Create after you confirm.
auth.harborHint: Local Harbor: try alex@harbor.test, blair@harbor.test, or casey@harbor.test. New email opens Create.
auth.newUserHint: New here? Request a link — we will open Create after you confirm your email.

create.step1Body: This name sits at the top of Today. Then choose who the money is for.
create.step2Body: Today counts the days until the next one.
create.step3Body: You can fix this later. Orbit uses it to split payday.
create.step3BodyTwice: Each time. You can fix this later. Orbit uses it to split payday.

desc.admin: Can edit the plan, the bank, and people
desc.member: Can spend, and can suggest changes
desc.advisor: Can look, and cannot move money
desc.read_only: Can look, and cannot move money

joinCap.owner: You can do everything, including billing.
joinCap.admin: You can edit the plan, the bank, and people.
joinCap.member: You can add purchases and suggest changes.
joinCap.advisor: You can look, and you cannot move money.
joinCap.read_only: You can look, and you cannot move money.

reasons.no_future_inflow: No payday is ahead, so there is no daily amount.
reasons.holiday_calendar_missing: The holiday calendar is missing. The last numbers are kept.
reasons.breach_mitigated: Daily spending was lowered to stay above what you keep.
reasons.breach_alert: Your balance is set to drop below what you keep.
reasons.sweep_skipped_no_sink: Leftover money had no goal to move to.
reasons.abandoned: This check stopped before it finished.
reasons.missing_discretionary: Spending is missing from this household.
reasons.tenant_not_found: This household could not be found.
reasons.debit_without_envelope: A payment was not tied to a bill.
reasons.pipeline_exception: Something went wrong. Orbit will try again overnight.
reasons.database_error: A database error stopped this check.

emails.signInLinkOnce: This link works once, for 24 hours.
emails.signInIgnore: If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this message.
emails.signInPreheader: Sign in to Orbit. This link works once, for 24 hours.
emails.signInBody: This link works once, for 24 hours. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this message.
emails.inviteSignIn: Sign in with this email address.
emails.inviteSignInThenOpen: Sign in with this email address, then open {link} to join.
emails.inviteTextRelative:
{inviter} invited you to {tenantName} on Orbit.
Sign in with this email address, then open {link} to join.

success.billOffPayday: Bill taken off payday. Its money stays set aside.
